verdict.rationale: Headless CI testing is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents running unit or integration tests headlessly against the engine (no test harness, null/headless graphics device, or CI guidance). The npm-installable engine and Vite/TypeScript scaffolding are only developer building blocks, and the AI-agent 'verification workflows' and Editor MCP verification are a different capability, so none of these earn credit.
